name: mutS homolog 3

function.text: MSH3 encodes DNA mismatch repair protein Msh3. Annotated molecular activities include ATP-dependent DNA damage sensor activity and mismatched DNA binding. It participates in DNA repair and mismatch repair.

germline.text: Retained constitutional disease associations include familial adenomatous polyposis 4 (autosomal recessive). Pathogenicity and inheritance depend on the specific allele and disorder.

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
